artifacts.summary: Confirms live the suite_selection_select sentinel-domination defect (a mixed set of one unmappable and one mappable path collapses to pure __FULL_SWEEP__, losing real suites); finds an existing compositional-union precedent in suite-resolver-lib.sh; enumerates the two production call sites (validate-artifact.sh, verify-deploy.sh Gate 8) sharing the fragile -eq-1-sentinel idiom; recommends a selector-layer fix plus required call-site adaptations in both consumers and the library's own header Usage example.

memory_candidates.content: agent-system/extensions/core's suite-selection-lib.sh suite_selection_select(PATH...) short-circuits: the moment ANY given path resolves to zero covering suites, it echoes the __FULL_SWEEP__ sentinel and returns immediately, discarding every real suite already resolved for other paths in the same multi-path call. suite_selection_unmapped (same library) does NOT have this flaw -- it correctly reports only the genuinely-unmapped subset per path. Any caller that must call the selector over a mixed set should be aware the raw multi-path suite_selection_select call is unsafe for that purpose; scripts/lib/suite-resolver-lib.sh already works around it by calling the selector one path at a time and unioning SELECT/UNRESOLVED results instead.

In agent-system/extensions/core, validate-artifact.sh's Tier Justification check (line ~821) and verify-deploy.sh's Gate 8 --gate8-touched narrowing (line ~1536) both detect 'no suite covers this' via the identical idiom: array length == 1 AND the single element equals SUITE_SELECTION_FULL_SWEEP_SENTINEL. Any change to suite_selection_select's return-value contract (e.g. making it return a union that can include the sentinel alongside real suite names) must update BOTH call sites to a 'does the output contain the sentinel' test instead, or Gate 8's fail-safe full-battery fallback silently regresses.

test-validate-artifact.sh (agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/tests/) carries a reusable Tier Justification fixture-builder pattern: make_tj_fixture() builds a synthetic two-phase plan with a caller-supplied Files-to-modify block and Tier Justification line; TJ_UNMAPPED_PATH is PID-suffixed ($$) specifically so the fixture's own literal path text never becomes a spurious stratum-(b) grep self-match against the test file once committed (confirmed live: an unsuffixed static placeholder DID self-match and flipped a sentinel-claim case into a suite-list case). Any new Tier-Justification-measurement fixture elsewhere in this corpus should reuse this PID-suffix precaution.
